projects.challenge: Present a complex real estate investment opportunity clearly while maintaining investor engagement and increasing webinar attendance throughout the campaign.
projects.title: Email Drip Campaign
projects.solution: Developed a multi-step email sequence covering the initial announcement, investment highlights, webinar registration, timed reminders, urgency messaging, and post-webinar follow-up with clear calls to action.
projects.tools: CRM & Email Automation • Email Copywriting • Webinar Registration • Investor Communication • PDF Deal Memorandum • Lead Nurturing
projects.description: A structured real estate investor email campaign designed to promote the Oslo Apartments investment opportunity, drive webinar registrations, communicate key deal metrics, and nurture prospective investors through timed reminders and post-webinar follow-up.

projects.challenge: Present a complex value-add multifamily investment opportunity in a way that clearly communicates the property, market fundamentals, renovation strategy, financial assumptions, projected returns, and key risks to prospective investors.
projects.title: CRE Pitch Decks
projects.solution: Developed a structured investor presentation that combines market research, financial analysis, renovation planning, risk mitigation, and visual storytelling to make the investment thesis easy to understand and professionally presented.
projects.description: A professional multifamily real estate investment presentation combining market analysis, property strategy, financial projections, risk management, and investor-focused storytelling for Admiral Ridge Apartments in West Seattle.
projects.result: Created a compelling investor pitch that clearly communicated the opportunity, projected returns, value-add strategy, and risk mitigation—helping strengthen investor confidence and support capital-raising efforts for the offering.

aboutText: I specialize in building real estate marketing, CRM automation, lead generation, email campaigns, landing pages, database systems, and digital workflows that help businesses operate more efficiently and convert opportunities into measurable results. My work combines creative marketing execution with structured business systems, from Canva-based marketing materials and website pages to automated follow-up, CRM management, reporting dashboards, SOP documentation, and process optimization. I focus on creating professional, organized, and scalable solutions that improve lead management, client communication, workflow efficiency, and overall business performance.
